title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: 101.Stresses that cutting methane emissions from oil and gas operations is one of the fastest, most cost-effective and immediately available ways to reduce GHG emissions; reiterates the importance of reducing methane emissions in the fossil fuel supply chains globally during the transition to clean energy systems; recalls that implementation challenges of Regulation(EU) 2024/1787 on the reduction of methane emissions in the energy sector vary widely across Member States; stresses that any implementation challenges need to be urgently reflected on, taking into account energy security and risks of spiking energy prices and inflation;
